title: Governance adjusts mainnet inflation
summary: The approved proposal corrects the initial inflation and holds the surplus minted so far in a common address.

context.problem: The network was minting far more coins than planned in a very short time.
context.cause: An initial parameter did not match the agreed inflation policy.
context.decision: The surplus minted because of the error is held in a common address; the validators who received it do not keep it.
context.plan: Once the infrastructure exists, the surplus will be used to create, neutrally, a first liquidity pool so participants can buy and trade the coin; the counterpart liquidity is expected to come from participants.
